target_mass.quote: a segmented 4 ton 6 Li-doped liquid scintillator detector

summary.plain: A movable tank of liquid scintillator divided into a grid of 154 long cells, read out by photomultiplier tubes at both ends, which records antineutrinos from the reactor at several distances.
summary.technical: Segmented 6Li-doped (0.1 % by mass) liquid-scintillator detector: an 11 x 14 array of 154 optically isolated segments (14.5 cm x 14.5 cm x 117.6 cm) read out by 308 PMTs; pulse-shape discrimination separates electron-like from neutron-capture signals.
